TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 23, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:30 PM

Jonathan de Armas, Chair  Shannon Holloway, Commissioner
Emily Woodman-Nance, Vice Chair  William Patterson, Commissioner
Nicole Callihan, Commissioner  Morgan Wheeler, Commissioner
Ashley Chiddick, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  alejandra.garcia@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56234  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Technology and Innovation
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, August 26, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56235  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56236  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the City of Long Beach AI
  and Data Privacy website.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56237  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Long Beach Collaboratory
  (LB Co-Lab), a community driven innovation program that connects Long Beach
  residents, City staff, and technology partners to collaboratively design solutions
  that enhance neighborhood quality of life.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56238  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the National Science
  Foundation (NSF) Grant: Trust, transparency, and technology: Building digital
  equity through a civic digital commons.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 23, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:30 PM

6.  26-56239  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Digital Inclusion Roadmap
  Implementation Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56240  Recommendation to consider the establishment of additional Ad Hoc Committees
  and/or dissolution of existing Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Technology and Innovation Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Alejandra Garcia (562) 570-6455 or
alejandra.garcia@longbeach.gov.
